full_name: Caroline Levine | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Humanities Radcliffe Fellow Cornell University
bio: Caroline Levine is one of a number of literary scholars rethinking the relationship between formalist methods and politics and the author of Forms: Whole, Rhythm, Hierarchy, Network (Princeton University Press, 2015) and The Activist Humanist: Form and Method in the Climate Crisis (Princeton University Press, 2023).
